binance_futures_ping.desc: Test connectivity to Binance USDT-M Futures REST API and measure server-time skew. No auth required. Call this first if signed requests fail with -1021 (timestamp outside recvWindow).

binance_futures_exchange_info.desc: Get current exchange trading rules and ALL symbol information. No auth required. Large response — use binance_futures_symbol_specs for a compact per-symbol view when you only need filters for one symbol.

params.symbol: Optional single symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT) to return only that symbol's info. Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_symbol_specs.desc: Compact per-symbol trading specs — minNotional (minimum order size in USDT), minQty, stepSize, tickSize, pricePrecision, quantityPrecision, maxLeverage, allowed orderTypes, and contractType. No auth required. Call this before placing an order to size correctly and avoid -1111 / -4164 errors.

binance_futures_klines.desc: Get OHLCV candlestick data for technical analysis. No auth required. Results returned in ASCENDING order (oldest first, newest last). Each candle is [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, trades, takerBuyBase, takerBuyQuote, ignore].

params.limit: Number of candles to return. Default 500, max 1500.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_ticker_price.desc: Get latest mark/last price for one symbol, or ALL symbols if omitted. No auth required. Use all-symbols mode to scan the market for momentum.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_ticker_24hr.desc: 24-hour rolling price change statistics — priceChange, priceChangePercent, high, low, volume, quoteVolume, weightedAvgPrice. No auth required. Omit symbol to scan all symbols (heavy response).

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_order_book.desc: Order book depth (bids and asks) for slippage estimation before placing a market order. No auth required.

binance_futures_mark_price.desc: Current mark price, index price, next funding rate and next funding time. No auth required. Omit symbol to return all symbols. Funding rate drives holding cost on perpetual futures — consult before long-duration positions.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). Omit to return all symbols.

binance_futures_open_interest.desc: Open interest (total outstanding contracts) for a symbol. Set history=true to return the open-interest timeseries via /futures/data/openInterestHist — useful for detecting trend acceleration or exhaustion. No auth required. Note: the history endpoint returns empty on testnet.

params.history: If true, return historical open interest instead of the current value. Default false.
params.period: History interval when history=true. One of: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 12h, 1d. Default 1h.
params.limit: Number of history data points when history=true. Default 30, max 500.

binance_futures_long_short_ratio.desc: Long/short account ratio — market sentiment signal. No auth required. Returns timeseries of longAccount, shortAccount, longShortRatio from /futures/data/topLongShortAccountRatio (top traders) or /futures/data/globalLongShortAccountRatio (global). Note: returns empty on testnet.

params.mode: Data source. One of: top (top traders, default) or global.
params.limit: Number of data points. Default 30, max 500.

binance_futures_account_info.desc: Authenticated account snapshot: wallet balance, unrealized PnL, available margin, total initial/maintenance margin, and position-mode (hedge vs one-way). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

binance_futures_position_risk.desc: Authenticated open-positions view: for each position returns entryPrice, markPrice, positionAmt, unrealizedProfit, leverage, marginType, liquidationPrice, notional. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

params.symbol: Optional symbol to filter. Omit to return all positions.

binance_futures_open_orders.desc: Authenticated list of all currently working (unfilled) orders. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

binance_futures_order_history.desc: Authenticated historical orders (filled, canceled, expired, rejected) for a symbol. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

params.limit: Max orders to return. Default 50, max 1000.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_income_history.desc: Authenticated realized PnL, commissions, funding fees, referral kickbacks. Use this to evaluate trading performance. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET.

params.income_type: Optional income type: REALIZED_PNL, COMMISSION, FUNDING_FEE, REFERRAL_KICKBACK, etc.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_change_leverage.desc: MUTATING. Change initial leverage for a symbol (1 to symbol maxLeverage). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. Affects new positions; existing position margin stays.

params.reasoning: Why this leverage is appropriate — shown to the user in the confirmation dialog. Required so the user can audit the AI's choice.

binance_futures_change_margin_type.desc: MUTATING. Switch margin mode for a symbol between ISOLATED (position-scoped loss) and CROSSED (account-wide margin). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. ISOLATED is safer for discrete AI-driven trades — loss is capped to the position's margin.

params.reasoning: Why this margin type is appropriate. Required for user audit.

binance_futures_change_position_mode.desc: MUTATING. Account-wide switch: hedge mode (dual LONG+SHORT positions per symbol) or one-way (single position, side determined by net). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. Must have no open positions or orders when switching.

params.dual_side_position: true = hedge mode, false = one-way mode. Required.
params.reasoning: Why this mode is appropriate. Required for user audit.

binance_futures_place_order.desc: MUTATING. Place a single USDT-M Futures order (MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET). Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. Auto-generates an idempotent newClientOrderId if omitted. On HTTP 503 'Unknown error' the call reconciles via order lookup before returning — do not retry without checking. For entry + SL + TP atomically, prefer binance_futures_place_bracket_order.

params.type: Order type: MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET. Required.
params.quantity: Base-asset quantity. Required unless close_position=true. Rounded to stepSize.
params.price: Limit price — required for LIMIT, STOP, TAKE_PROFIT.
params.stop_price: Trigger price — required for STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET.
params.time_in_force: GTC (default for LIMIT), IOC, FOK, GTX (post-only), GTD.
params.good_till_date_ms: Required when time_in_force=GTD. Auto-cancel timestamp in ms.
params.reduce_only: If true, order can only reduce an existing position. Ignored in hedge mode — use position_side there.
params.close_position: If true (STOP_MARKET/TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET only), closes the entire position. quantity is ignored.
params.position_side: Hedge mode only: LONG, SHORT, or BOTH (default one-way).
params.working_type: MARK_PRICE or CONTRACT_PRICE (default). Which price triggers conditional orders.
params.price_match: NONE (default), OPPONENT, OPPONENT_5/10/20, QUEUE, QUEUE_5/10/20. When set, price is auto-chosen and the price param is ignored.
params.price_protect: If true, conditional orders reject when trigger is too far from mark price.
params.new_client_order_id: Optional custom client order ID (≤36 chars, [0-9A-Za-z_.-]). Auto-generated if omitted.
params.dry_run: If true, validates via POST /fapi/v1/order/test and does NOT place the order. Skips the confirmation dialog.
params.reasoning: Mandatory when dry_run=false: strategy, signals, and risk rationale. Shown to the user in the confirmation dialog.

binance_futures_place_bracket_order.desc: MUTATING. Recommended primary trade entry: places entry + stop-loss + take-profit atomically via /fapi/v1/batchOrders. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. Client-side validates stop_loss_price is on the loss side and take_profit_price on the profit side relative to side. On partial failure, default rolls back by cancelling any legs that succeeded.

params.side: BUY (long) or SELL (short) for the entry. Required.
params.type: Entry order type — MARKET or LIMIT. Required.
params.quantity: Base-asset quantity for the entry. Required.
params.stop_loss_price: Trigger price for the STOP_MARKET exit leg. Required.
params.take_profit_price: Trigger price for the TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET exit leg. Required.
params.leverage: Optional — if set, calls change_leverage first.
params.margin_type: Optional ISOLATED or CROSSED — if set, calls change_margin_type first. Recommend ISOLATED for discrete AI trades.
params.working_type: MARK_PRICE or CONTRACT_PRICE (default) for SL/TP triggers.
params.time_in_force: Only for LIMIT entry. Default GTC.
params.on_partial_failure: rollback (default) — cancel successful legs on any failure; or warn — return a warning and leave partial state for the caller to resolve.
params.dry_run: If true, validates each leg via /fapi/v1/order/test and does NOT place any orders. Skips the confirmation dialog.
params.reasoning: Mandatory when dry_run=false: full strategy, entry thesis, SL/TP logic, R:R, and sizing rationale. Shown to the user.

binance_futures_cancel_order.desc: MUTATING. Cancel a single order by orderId or origClientOrderId. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

params.order_id: Order ID. Provide either this or orig_client_order_id.
params.orig_client_order_id: Client order ID. Provide either this or order_id.
params.reasoning: Why the order is being cancelled. Required for user audit.

binance_futures_cancel_all_open_orders.desc: MUTATING. Cancel ALL working orders for a symbol. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. Does not close positions — only removes pending orders.

params.reasoning: Why all orders are being cancelled. Required for user audit.

binance_futures_close_position.desc: MUTATING. Close an open position immediately via reduceOnly MARKET order (or LIMIT if price is provided). Auto-detects position size and side from /fapi/v2/positionRisk — no need to compute opposite side yourself. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. If the position is zero, returns an error.

params.quantity: Optional quantity to close. Omit to close the entire position.
params.price: Optional LIMIT price. If provided, places a reduceOnly LIMIT order instead of MARKET.
params.time_in_force: Only applies if price is set. GTC (default), IOC, FOK.
params.position_side: For hedge-mode accounts: LONG or SHORT. Omit for one-way mode (default).
params.dry_run: If true, validates via /fapi/v1/order/test without execution.
params.reasoning: Why the position is being closed. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true or dry_run=true.

binance_futures_commission_rate.desc: Get maker and taker commission (fee) rates for a symbol. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Call this when sizing an order to account for fees — typical fees are 0.02% maker / 0.04% taker on USDT-M Futures but may be lower with BNB discount or VIP tier.

binance_futures_modify_order.desc: MUTATING. Modify an existing LIMIT order's price and/or quantity via PUT /fapi/v1/order. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Prompts user confirmation unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true. Use this to tighten SL, widen TP, or re-price a stale LIMIT without the cancel-and-replace race window. Only works for LIMIT orders — STOP / TAKE_PROFIT orders cannot be modified (cancel and replace instead).

params.side: BUY or SELL. Required by Binance (must match the original order's side).
params.order_id: Order ID to modify. Provide either this or orig_client_order_id.
params.orig_client_order_id: Client order ID to modify. Provide either this or order_id.
params.quantity: New quantity. Omit to keep current.
params.price: New price. Omit to keep current.
params.reasoning: Why the order is being modified. Required unless BINANCE_SKIP_ASK_USER=true.

binance_futures_funding_rate_history.desc: Get historical funding rate data for a symbol. No auth required. USDT-M Futures fund every 8 hours (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC); negative rates mean shorts pay longs (bullish-leaning), positive means longs pay shorts (bearish-leaning). Use this to time entries around funding events or gauge directional bias.

params.limit: Number of funding events to return. Default 100, max 1000.
params.start_time_ms: Optional start time in milliseconds since epoch.
params.end_time_ms: Optional end time in milliseconds since epoch.

binance_futures_position_overview.desc: Aggregated pre-trade snapshot combining account balance, margin usage, open positions (with uPnL), and per-symbol maker/taker fees — in a single call. Requires BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET. Ideal as the first call before sizing a new trade: gives you total free margin, current risk exposure, and fee costs in one shot. If symbol is provided, fee rate for that symbol is included.

params.symbol: Optional symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT) to include commission rate and focused position data.

binance_futures_ta_snapshot.desc: Technical analysis snapshot: fetches klines and computes ATR(14), EMA(9/21/50), RSI(14), and Bollinger Bands(20, 2σ) server-side. No auth required. Returns last N candles plus the indicator values for the most recent close. Saves tokens vs the LLM computing indicators from raw klines. Use ATR for SL/TP sizing (1.5–3× ATR typical), EMA for trend, RSI for overbought/oversold, Bollinger for volatility envelope.

params.limit: Number of candles to fetch for the computation. Default 100, max 500. EMA(50) requires ≥50 candles; below 21 the snapshot returns an error.
params.include_candles: If true, include the underlying klines in the response. Default false — only indicators.
